name: Sutherland Shire
housingNote: The Shire's detached homes on north-facing blocks are well-suited to solar — typical installed system sizes run from 6.6 kW to 13 kW. Beach proximity means saltair-rated equipment matters.
evNote: The F6 and Princes Highway carry daily Shire-to-CBD commutes of 25–45 km each way — a range where home charging overnight works well.
systemContext: Typical residential systems in this area: 6.6 kW to 13.2 kW solar with an optional 10–13 kWh battery.

name: Hills District
housingType: large family homes on generous blocks
housingNote: Hills District homes are typically large, two-storey, with ample north-facing roof area. Average system sizes here run from 10 kW to 20 kW, and households often prioritise battery storage alongside solar for evening self-consumption.
evNote: The Hills to CBD commute is among Sydney's longest at 45–60 km return — making a home EV charger a strong value proposition for residents switching to electric.
systemContext: Typical residential systems in this area: 10 kW to 20 kW solar with 10–15 kWh battery storage.

metaDesc: Solar panels, battery storage and EV charger installation across the Hills District. Licensed NSW electrician serving Castle Hill, Kellyville, Baulkham Hills, Rouse Hill and surrounding suburbs.

name: Northern Beaches
housingType: a mix of beachside homes, terraces and family houses
housingNote: Northern Beaches properties range from compact beachside terraces with limited roof area to larger family homes on the plateau — system sizing varies significantly. Coastal saltair requirements apply across the whole peninsula.
evNote: The single road corridor to the CBD — Warringah Road and the Spit Bridge — makes the Northern Beaches one of Sydney's highest-traffic commuter routes. EV charging at home removes the need for public charging entirely.
systemContext: Typical residential systems in this area: 6.6 kW to 10 kW solar with optional battery storage.
metaTitle: Solar, Battery & EV Charger Installation — Northern Beaches | Oz Home Energy
metaDesc: Solar panels, battery storage and EV charger installation across the Northern Beaches. Licensed NSW electrician serving Manly, Dee Why, Collaroy, Narrabeen, Mona Vale and surrounding suburbs.

name: Inner West
housingType: terrace houses, semis and Federation bungalows
housingNote: Inner West terraces and semis present unique solar challenges: small roof footprints, shared walls and heritage overlays in some streets require careful system design. Micro-inverter and string-with-optimiser configurations often suit these rooftops better than a standard single-string layout.
evNote: Inner West residents typically drive shorter distances, but overnight home charging still saves time and cost compared to destination charging.
systemContext: Typical residential systems in this area: 3.3 kW to 6.6 kW solar, sized to the available unshaded roof area.
metaTitle: Solar, Battery & EV Charger Installation — Inner West Sydney | Oz Home Energy
metaDesc: Solar panels, battery storage and EV charger installation across Inner West Sydney. Licensed NSW electrician serving Newtown, Marrickville, Leichhardt, Balmain and surrounding suburbs.

name: St George
housingType: solid middle-ring brick homes with good roof area
housingNote: St George homes are typically solid brick on mid-sized blocks, well-positioned for solar. Being close to the bay introduces coastal saltair considerations for equipment selection. Most properties suit systems of 6.6 kW to 10 kW.
evNote: The Princes Highway and M8 corridor connects St George to the CBD and Airport precinct — a daily commute where home EV charging makes financial sense.
systemContext: Typical residential systems in this area: 6.6 kW to 10 kW solar with optional battery.

name: North Shore
housingType: established family homes, many with large north-facing roofs
housingNote: Upper North Shore properties on larger blocks often achieve excellent solar yields thanks to generous north-facing roof planes and relatively low shading. System sizes of 10 kW to 20 kW are common, and battery storage is increasingly popular for evening self-consumption.
evNote: North Shore households are among Sydney's highest early adopters of EVs. A dedicated home charger delivers faster, more reliable overnight charging than a domestic power point.
systemContext: Typical residential systems in this area: 10 kW to 20 kW solar with 10–15 kWh battery storage.

name: Penrith
housingType: family homes on standard suburban blocks

evNote: The Western Motorway and Great Western Highway carry some of Sydney's longest daily commutes — Penrith to Parramatta or the CBD is 50–80 km return. Home EV charging overnight maximises cost savings on that distance.
systemContext: Typical residential systems in this area: 6.6 kW to 13.2 kW solar with optional battery storage.
